d:
The Warriors defeated the Nuggets, 134-114 tonight in Denver. Yaxel Lendeborg finished with a team-high 31 points along with 12 rebounds and 6 assists for the Warriors, while Stephen Curry tallied 24 points, 3 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. DeMar DeRozan recorded 21 points, 4 rebounds and 2 steals. The Warriors improve their record to 1-3 with the win, while the Nuggets fall to 1-2 for the season.
